blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY— Some 31 of the 55 barangays of Catarman in Northern Samar are already experiencing reduced water supply as the dry conditions brought by the El Niño phenomenon begins to prevail. This situation prompted local authorities to explore additional water sources. They also urged residents to conserve water. The Catarman Water District has begun rationing water in affected communities since the last month of September. It is planning to secure a bulk water supplier to serve as a buffer source as available supplies become scarce.
